files.content:
name: Upload test SARIF

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: write

jobs:
  upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Upload SARIF
        uses: github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v3
        with:
          sarif_file: test-results.sarif
          category: security-alert-pipeline-test
